plugins.name: cc-context-mod
plugins.description: Live context window forecast and MiniMax M Plan / Token Plan balance, drawn above the prompt.

plugins.name: cc-code-format-mod
plugins.description: Rewrites every fenced code block in an LLM response to the language's standard style (Prettier for the web stack, black for Python, gofmt / rustfmt / shfmt where installed).

plugins.name: cc-notify-mod
plugins.description: Forwards Claude Code task completion, repeated Bash failures, and AskUserQuestion prompts to the macOS Notification Center, with a one-line focus/status indicator above the prompt.
